explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain precisely why the original objective 510000 drops to 472200 by tracing the year-0 two-year product through the business brief, `general_parameters.csv`, `src/current_heuristic.py`, and `src/formulation.tex`. Your answer must name the exact code variables and CSV fields that implement the statement that the year-0 two-year investment settles after the year-2 reinvestment cut-off, identify which revised solver constraints are binding versus slack (including `_C3` and `_C5`), interpret their dual values in business terms, and quantify the objective impact relative to the original model with specific coefficients/amounts. Also explain why using the dual/shadow price of `_C5` or `_C3` to linearly extrapolate a large policy change in `max_option2_start` or the late-settlement rule would be invalid here.
